chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Mutawakkil (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) said, while Mu'awiya was writing between his hands, and he pointed his hand to his waist with the sword: 'Whoever encounters this man one day as a commander, let him cut open his waist with the sword.'

A man from those who had heard that from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) saw him one day while he was preaching to the people in the Levant. He drew his sword, then walked towards him, and the people stood between him and Mu'awiya, saying: 'O servant of Allah, what is wrong with you?'
He said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Whoever encounters this man one day as a commander, let him cut open his waist with the sword.'
He said: 'Do you know who appointed him?' He said: 'No.' They said: 'The Commander of the Believers, Umar.'
Then the man said: 'We heard and obeyed the Commander of the Believers.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Belieavers (Title for Caliphs/Imams)
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةُ: Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, the Umayyad caliph

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Mu'awiya and how did the companions react to his appointment by Umar?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar* highlights the Prophet’s specific prophecy regarding Mu'awiya’s future rule, emphasizing the tension between divine knowledge and political obedience. The narrative illustrates the Shia principle of *al-samt* (silence/composure) in the face of unjust authority, as the companion accepts Umar’s appointment despite knowing Mu'awiya’s destined role, thereby validating the legitimacy of the Caliphate while acknowledging Mu'awiya’s unique status.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Musa bin Mutawakkil, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himyari, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Isa, from Hasan bin Mahbub, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, that he said: I heard Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him, say:

The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said, while Mu’awiya was writing between his hands, and he lowered his hand to his waist at the sword: The one who will manage to observe him one day as a commander, let him cut his waist with the sword.

He was then seen by a man from among those who had heard that from Allah’s Messenger, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, one day while he was lecturing in the Levant for the people. He then drew his sword, then walked to him, and the people stood before him and him, and they said: O servant of Allah, what is it with you?
He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say: «The one who will manage to observe him one day as a commander, let him cut his waist with the sword.»
He said: Then he said: Do you know who assigned him? He said: No. They said: The Commander of the Believers, Umar.
Then the man said: (I am in) Hearing and Obedience to the Commander of the Believers.
